narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#3434

## Problem

The #3640 all-accept auto-stamp always remaining-set-replaces the catalog chip to `design-critique:triage-ready`. That name reads as "ready to ingest and build this body." The synthesis-accepted sentence is the same whether the arc concludes "build this" or "this cannot be built as written -- recut first."

Measured on #4200 (2026-09-05). Operator confirmed an all-accept lean whose next-build contract was recut (repo-wide lookup or drop cross-issue overlap; add a task verb). Path 1 auto-posted the verified-claims table, posted `design-critique: synthesis accepted, because agents agreed (empty disagreement set)`, and applied `triage-ready`. The list then showed a recut-needed draft as ready.

The contract already says ingest does not take the chip as clearance (latest successor lean + synthesis-accepted line). That does not help operators or agents who filter on the chip. Recut is defined as dropping `triage-ready` and re-applying `mechanism-shaped` -- so the protocol stamps ready, then expects a recut to unstamp it.

## Current catalog

`DESIGN_CRITIQUE_CATALOG_CHIPS` (`packages/core/src/design-critique/exclusive-chip.ts`) is a closed two-name set:

- `design-critique:mechanism-shaped` -- in-flight, `judgmentGates` match
- `design-critique:triage-ready` -- bound / list-visible convenience

`scm:issue:design-critique-chip` remaining-set-replaces within that set. A third chip is a catalog change, not a label invention in the field.

## Proposed direction (fork, not locked)

The auto-stamp must not leave `triage-ready` on an issue whose accepted lean is "recut, do not implement this body."

Candidate shapes (arc should pick one):

1. **Third exclusive chip**, e.g. `design-critique:recut-needed` -- last chip wins; `judgmentGates` still matches only `mechanism-shaped`; ingest still reads the lean, not the chip.
2. **Do not auto-stamp `triage-ready`** when the lean's next-build reading is recut / cannot-bind-as-written; stay on `mechanism-shaped` or post synthesis-accepted without flipping the chip.
3. **Rename or split `triage-ready`** so "arc complete" and "this body is the implement contract" are not the same list state.

Do not treat chip as ingest clearance. Do not add a halt chip. Do not DELETE-then-POST.

## Acceptance (draft)

- [ ] An all-accept bind whose lean is recut / not-the-next-build-contract does not display `design-critique:triage-ready`.
- [ ] `judgmentGates` still matches only `mechanism-shaped`.
- [ ] Ingest still keys off the completed-arc record + latest successor lean, not the chip.
- [ ] Recut of a later body still opens a new arc (mechanism-shaped, old record does not clear the new lean).
- [ ] Closed catalog stays exclusive remaining-set (one write). Content-contract tests lock the new names.
- [ ] #4200 (or a fixture) is the exemplar: empty-disagreement recut lean must not look implement-ready on the label list.

## Non-goals

- Re-litigating that synthesis-accepted prose is identical across verdicts (that is load-bearing).
- Making the chip ingest clearance.
- Classifying recut by NLP of the lean.

Refs #3434, #3640, #3642, #4200, `content/contracts/design-critique.md` Recut / Operator verbs / Bind after accepted synthesis.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-06T00:41:27Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Dispatch SHA: `20f9dfbda67746fc0367b4856cfeb016e6e96213`
Ceiling: 5555840550. Charter: refutation.

Verdict on the refutation target: **not refuted as a hole**. Auto-stamp remaining-set-replaces to `triage-ready` on every all-accept bind. It does not read the lean. Ingest already ignores the chip. The list still showed a recut-needed #4200 as ready (synthesis 5555695949), then recut had to unstamp it (5555835582). The cheap list-visible lie is real. The recorded **fork 2** cannot carry the job without a new stamp.

## `sharpens-framing` -- Fork 2 has no mechanical discriminator

Evidence. At this SHA, `DESIGN_CRITIQUE_CATALOG_CHIPS` is two names (`packages/core/src/design-critique/exclusive-chip.ts` lines 4-7). `CHIP_ALIASES` in `packages/core/src/scm/design-critique-chip.ts` is the same two. `DESIGN_CRITIQUE_MARKER_LABEL` is only `design-critique:mechanism-shaped` (`packages/core/src/orchestration/judgment-policy.ts`). Bind path 1 in `content/contracts/design-critique.md` auto-stamps `triage-ready` from a total all-accept map plus operator confirm. Nothing in that path inspects lean prose. The issue non-goal is classifying recut by NLP of the lean.

Concrete failure mode. An implementer told to "skip triage-ready when the lean is recut" either parses English (the non-goal) or invents a parent judgment that ADR-005 already refused (stamp, do not compute). Fork 2 as written is unsatisfiable.

Disposition consequence. Mechanize fork 2 as a closed token on the successor lean (a line-start auto-stamp can match, in the same family as `Lean:`), or drop fork 2 from the pickable set. Do not leave "when the lean reads recut" as an implementable shape.

## `sharpens-framing` -- Fork 3 is a list migration, not a local auto-stamp tweak

Evidence. `triage-ready` is already on bound issues (measured: #4200 carried it until this session recut). Content-contract tests pin the two catalog names and the `--chip triage-ready|mechanism-shaped` usage string.

Concrete failure mode. Rename or split without a migration leaves two "arc complete" chips on the list, or silently retags every previously-ready issue. That is repo-wide vocabulary change, not the #4200-shaped local miss.

Disposition consequence. v1 default is not fork 3. If the arc still wants rename, AC must name alias-or-rewrite of existing `triage-ready`. Otherwise pick a third exclusive chip or stay on `mechanism-shaped` without flipping.

## `footnote` -- A third name is a closed-set change across exclusive-chip, CHIP_ALIASES, and content-contract

`resolveDesignCritiqueChipArg` fails closed on an unknown `--chip`. Adding a GitHub label in the field without those three surfaces leaves the parent verb unable to write `recut-needed` and tempts additive `scm:issue:edit --add-label`, which breaks remaining-set. The issue AC already says catalog plus content-contract; this footnote names the CLI alias table as the third lock.

## Injection / swarm lens

A last-wins catalog chip is list-visible state anyone with label write can flip. Same as the current two-name set. Do not give a third chip fail-closed halt meaning (halt chip is a non-goal). Chip apply miss stays non-blocking convenience.

## Road not taken

NLP of the lean -- issue non-goal; would re-open ADR-005. Halt chip -- issue non-goal; would add a label the contract forbids.

## Steelman

Steelman for keeping `triage-ready` on every all-accept bind: the chip means arc-complete bookkeeping, ingest already reads the lean, operators can learn. That would flip the hole only if the measured #4200 misread did not happen. It did. The list-visible name is the operator surface. The steelman does not survive that measurement.

**Lean:**

## In plain English

The hole is real: all-accept auto-stamp always puts `triage-ready` on the issue, even when the next-build contract is recut. Ingest already ignores the chip. The list does not. #4200 measured that.

Fork 2 as written cannot be built. Auto-stamp does not read lean prose, and NLP is a non-goal. Recut vs implement has to be a closed token, or fork 2 is dropped.

Fork 3 (rename or split `triage-ready`) is a list migration. v1 should not take it.

If this map is confirmed, the next-build contract is: add a third exclusive chip (`design-critique:recut-needed`), drive auto-stamp from a closed token on the successor lean, keep `judgmentGates` matching only `mechanism-shaped`, and leave ingest on the completed-arc record. Confirming does not start a build.

Parent forward verdict: third chip plus token; not rename. Disposition is per-heading below. Non-self-arbitration: this parent authored Stop 1 (5555840550) and, after spawn_subagent was refused on ritual-stale HEAD, also posted the critic comment (5555852837). Same-family, same session. Confirming this map is an operator act, not the parent clearing its own critique. What this arc does not do: implement, bind synthesis, or ingest.

Round 1 dispatched 1 sibling: [5555852837](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4205#issuecomment-5555852837) (grok-4.6). This map supersedes Stop 1 write-back 5555840550.

## Takes

### 5555852837 / Fork 2 has no mechanical discriminator -- accept-into-contract
Mechanize recut vs implement as a closed token on the successor lean that auto-stamp can match, or drop fork 2. Do not classify recut by reading lean prose.

### 5555852837 / Fork 3 is a list migration, not a local auto-stamp tweak -- accept-into-contract
v1 does not rename `triage-ready`. Remaining pick is a third exclusive chip (with CHIP_ALIASES plus content-contract) or stay on `mechanism-shaped` without flipping. Forward verdict is the third chip.

## Residual

None that still changes disposition once the token-plus-third-chip reading is accepted. Stay-on-mechanism-shaped-without-flipping is the operator fork inside the second heading, not a third heading. Footnote (CLI alias table) is census only.

Operator verbs that apply: **accept**, **retry differences**, **walk all**.
